_readme: Golden cases for the ask pack router (fund-grade build S4). Two case modes share the file: mode=router pins the classifier's pack selection for one question (scored set-vs-set: pass = exact match, score = Jaccard so a near-miss beats garbage); mode=grounded runs the PRODUCTION route_packs -> load_packs chain against the live DB and checks contract invariants (selected_includes <= the live selection; require_kinds present among loaded items — only packs certain to materialize belong there: holdings/performance always emit an item when selected, even tracker-offline; every loaded kind was selected; item text non-empty and within its char budget). expected_packs/selected_includes/require_kinds entries must be PACK_KEYS members — tests/test_llm_evals_ask_router.py enforces it.

cases.question: What did NU management say about credit quality on the last call?
cases.notes: transcript question — document evidence only

cases.question: Summarize META's latest 10-K risk factors.
cases.notes: filing question — empty selection is the correct answer

cases.question: What's my cost basis on NU?
cases.notes: cost basis lives only in the tracker holdings pack

cases.question: What's my biggest position right now?
cases.notes: pure weights question

cases.question: Should I trim MELI and add TSM with the proceeds?
cases.notes: the flagship swap question — sizing rule: holdings + dcf + conviction

cases.question: Should I size NU up to 15% of the book?
cases.notes: sizing against a stated target

cases.question: Which names trade furthest below model fair value?
cases.notes: valuation-gap screen — dcf alone answers it

cases.question: How am I doing against SPY this year?
cases.notes: benchmark-relative results

cases.question: What's working and what's dragging in the book this year?
cases.notes: results + which positions — the 'usually with holdings' rule

cases.question: What did I decide about MELI last quarter, and did it play out?
cases.notes: decision ledger with outcomes

cases.question: What open questions am I carrying on NU?
cases.notes: journal memory question

cases.question: Am I too concentrated?
cases.notes: concentration stats live in the performance pack; holdings names the weights

cases.question: Remind me of my conviction and target weight on NU.
cases.notes: the analyst's own stated posture

cases.question: Is NU cheap relative to your DCF right now?
cases.notes: single-name valuation gap

cases.question: Walk me through MELI's take-rate trend from the filings.
cases.notes: company metric narrative — no portfolio state needed

cases.question: Did adding NU actually beat just buying SPY?
cases.notes: per-position alpha vs cashflow-matched benchmark

cases.question: Should I trim NU here?
cases.notes: NU has dcf_runs rows on the prod DB; holdings always materializes (offline item if the tracker is down)

cases.question: What's my cost basis and unrealized P&L on MELI?
cases.notes: holdings selection + the item materializing either live or as an explicit offline marker

cases.question: What have I decided about NU in the past, and how did those calls work out?
cases.notes: decisions must be SELECTED; materialization not required — the prod decisions table is legitimately empty until decision_extractor runs (verified 2026-06-12), and an empty store correctly contributes nothing

cases.question: What open watch-items am I carrying across the book?
cases.notes: journal must be selected; presence not required (open notes can legitimately be zero at any moment)
